---
title: "check-figure-placement.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, failing-by-default check that flags a figure a pull request adds
when the page does not discuss it or places it away from its example.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-11-02) is that every figure is discussed
and cross-referenced in prose,
and that a figure specific to one example or exercise
is nested inside that example's or exercise's div.

## What it flags

- **Uncited.**
  No `@fig-id`, and no `[text](#fig-id)` link,
  appears on the page outside the figure itself.
  A citation on another page does not count.
- **Unnested.**
  The figure is not inside an `#exm-`, `#exr-` or `#sol-` div,
  and the nearest non-blank line before it closes one.
  A figure that several examples share follows prose, so it is not flagged.

A figure is a div or image labelled `{#fig-id}`,
or a code chunk with `#| label: fig-id`.
A figure inside a code fence or HTML comment is not counted.
Only a figure whose lines include one the pull request adds is reported,
so nothing existing is swept.
`<!-- figure-placement: allow -->` on the figure or inside its div exempts it.

With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to measure every tracked file in full.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default   | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | --------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd'` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`      | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `true`    | Fail the workflow when a figure is uncited or unnested. Set `false` for warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`   | Check every tracked file in full instead of only added lines. |

## Usage

```yaml
jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-figure-placement.yml@v3
```

Copy [`examples/check-figure-placement.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-figure-placement.yml).
